stations.title: Theo
stations.say: Why is 900 last on the page?
stations.note: He sorted the prices, cheapest first.

stations.title: A plain sort
stations.text: It compares the prices as text, like words.

stations.title: Shop page
stations.text: Prices from the lowest, the shelf untouched.

captions: Theo puts the shelf's prices on the shop page, cheapest first.
A plain sort compares them as text, so 900 lands after 4500.
You sort copies the right way and ask yes or no questions about stock.
Now the price list starts with the cheapest candle, and the shelf keeps its order.
The shop can order its lists and question them. Next, whole orders.
